title: GEORGE MICHAEL GILTO Dispatched A Lively Single Track, "BLOCKED OUT"
htmlContent:
Australian-based hip-hop artist GEORGE MICHAEL GILTO delivers a powerful track with "BLOCKED OUT." The heavy autotune and grime influences in the track showcase GILTO's unique style, blending a mix of classic and modern elements. With hard-hitting rhymes and a driving beat, "BLOCKED OUT" will get listeners excited and ready for more from this up-and-coming rapper.

 GILTO's style and sound are one to watch in the rapidly evolving hip-hop scene.
